text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornInAmericanCity(x) ::: x is born in an American city.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
WrittenIn(x, y) ::: x is written in year y.
CreatedBy(x, y) ::: x is created by y.
FamilyHistory(x) ::: x is Family History.
FamilySecrets(x) ::: x is Family Secrets.
City(x, y) ::: x is a city in country y.
Y = "2003" ::: the year 2003.
Y = "2003" ::: the specific year.

Premises:
¬Podcast(novel) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInAmericanCity(x) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, then the person is American.
∀x (Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) → Author(y, x)) ::: If a book is a novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is American.
WrittenBy(FamilyHistory, DaniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Book(FamilyHistory) ::: Family History is a book.
WrittenIn(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is written in 2003.
CreatedBy(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
FamilySecrets is a podcast. ::: (implied from context but not explicitly formalized here)
Boston is an American city. ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
∃x (Author(x, DaniShapiro) ∧ Book(x) ∧ Novel(x)) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
